response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG(CASE WHEN feerate = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (rebrate - feerate) / feerate END) AS avg_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS bench FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_reb) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotal, AVG(g.avg_gap) AS avg_of_avg_gap, AVG(g.avg_reb - b.bench) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.bench IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_reb > b.bench
